findings: Payment endpoints do not share one interchangeable contract; no route merge/deletion is justified.
Admin Orders list applies a 1,000-parent-order cap before joining all item rows in one D1 read; test checks grouping, null prices and bounded query count.
Order contact snapshot prevents public checkout from overwriting a customer profile and keeps purchase-time contact details associated with the order; tests and migration 0007 assert this contract.
Order detail is a separate route/view driven by selected order ID; it reuses the Admin orders dataset. UI fixture screenshots and mock tests do not prove authenticated live backend acceptance.

The zero-byte reference viewer was removed; live PR file list confirms 384 changed paths, one HTML file (the Admin UI), the approved PNG still in the Git tree, and 318 compact history records retained.
B1 remains partial; no more deletions justified without full consumer/provenance evidence.
